statement: Neither native Dolphin MP+Nunchuk nor its MP-only control ran with hid-generic in W9e because per-device binding was refused. The first unpassed checkpoint is the host binding prerequisite, before F6. No observation establishes whether F6, A40020/32, A40040/16 or decoded Nunchuk and gyro would pass, whether non-Dolphin A400F0=55 would remain, or whether kernel evdev, MotionPlus and xwiimote access would be absent under a successful generic binding. Existing W9 bound-kernel observations remain separate. No adoption pass follows.

applicability.revision: Original virtual model; physical revisions unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. W9e test/dev binding investigation only; release policy remains gated on virtualgamepad #258. No physical, radio, rate, game or challenge evidence.
